source.title: A competitor did not fully don the blindfond but was not able to see the puzzle
source.content:
During 3x3x3 blindfolded attempt, a competitor donned the blindfold in such a way that they were able to see the judge but not the puzzle. The judge said that at some point of the blindfolded phase the competitor looked at them for a few seconds and then continued the execution.

[Regulation B4b](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#B4b) says:

> B4b) The competitor must not apply moves or intentional changes in alignment to the puzzle before they have fully donned the blindfold. Penalty: disqualification of the attempt (DNF).

Since the competitor was able to see the judge and other surrounding, the WRC decided that the blindfold was **not** fully donned, and therefore **the attempt should be changed to DNF**.

translation.title: 眼罩未完全戴好，虽看不到魔方但能看到裁判
translation.content:
一次三阶盲拧中，选手的眼罩戴法使其能看到裁判，但看不到魔方。裁判表示，盲拧阶段某时刻，选手看着自己数秒后继续还原。

[B4b](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#B4b) 规定：
> 眼罩完全戴好前，不得转动魔方或故意改变其对齐状态，否则该次尝试 DNF。

由于选手能看见裁判和周围环境，WRC 认定眼罩**未完全戴好**，因此**该次尝试应改为 DNF**。
